Internship AB Inbev (Jupiler, Corona, Flying Fish, ...) - Brand management - 3 to 6 months - Leuven  #Talent  Purpose:  Brewing the world's most loved beers and building brands consumers love, AB InBev is where ownership, ambition, and action thrive.  We empower you to dream big, lead change, and create a long-lasting legacy.  We value relentless problem-solvers who take accountability, embrace challenges, and turn bold goals into results through resilience and hard work.  That's Who We Are: Come and OWN IT.  Internship description:  The purpose of the role is to assist the Senior Brand Manager(s) in driving growth for one of our key brands [Jupiler, Corona or Flying Fish].  

Our Brand teams bridge the gap between supporting brand building, brand activations, campaigns, and consumer engagement. We're looking for a proactive and ambitious students to join us and gain hands-on experience in one of the most dynamic and exciting industries. This is more than just an internship - it's a chance to start your career with us. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time roles post-graduation.  What will you do during the internship? 

• Assist with planning and follow-up of activations and campaigns  
• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners   
Internship duration:  Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.   Work environment  Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation:  Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship) 
 
What we're looking for: 

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University.  
 
 
Why build your career with us:  We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities.  UNIQUE CULTURE  We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication.   BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.  GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth.  If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

Our client is an international logistics leader and is looking for an Air Export Administrative Agent to strengthen their Air Export Team in the Machelen region.

You will work closely with customers, airlines, and internal departments to guarantee smooth and efficient operations.

Air Freight Administration

• Manage and process shipment-related documentation accurately. 
 
• Upload shipment documents into electronic document management systems.
 
• Support the handling of shipment pre-alerts and storage requirements, including temperature-sensitive shipments. 
 
• Follow up on active container leasing and end-of-lease activities.  
 

Customer Service
 

 
• Inform customers proactively about shipment status updates and delays.
 
• Respond professionally to customer inquiries.
 
• Ensure customer requirements and operating procedures are consistently respected.  
 

Compliance & Operational Excellence
 

 
• Escalate operational issues to management when necessary.
 
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase operational efficiency and service quality.
 
• Ensure compliance with company procedures, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
 
• Follow up on operational discrepancies and system-related issues.
 
• Assist with claim notifications to airlines when required.  
 

 
 

 

Your Profile:
 

We are looking for a motivated logistics professional who thrives in a dynamic international environment.
 

Requirements
 

 
• Knowledge of the air freight process and transport documentation.
 
• A background in Transport & Logistics or a similar education is highly valued.
 
• Administrative experience or strong administrative skills.
 
• Comfortable managing multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
 
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.  
 

Proactive and able to work independently. 
 

Good computer skills and ability to quickly learn new systems.
 

 
• Fluent in Dutch and English (spoken and written).
 
• Strong communication skills with both customers and colleagues. 
 

Personal Qualities
 

 
• Customer-focused and service-minded.
 
• Flexible and willing to go the extra mile when operational needs require it.
 
• No strict "9-to-5" mentality.
 
• Professional attitude and willingness to follow company procedures, policies, and dress code.
 
• Strong team player with a positive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. • You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

With an annual turnover of €6 million and 90% export activity, 
I-Coats is a dynamic and internationally oriented company with strong growth ambitions.
 

To strengthen the team, we are looking for an experienced and technically strong: 
Project Manager
 

Your role 
 

In this role, you will take a leading position in the development of coatings for customer-specific applications, operating at the intersection of R&D and practical implementation. You will act both as a technical expert and as a project lead, playing a key role in translating customer needs into high-performance and innovative coating solutions.
 

As 
Project Manager, you will be end-to-end responsible for the development and implementation of tailor-made coatings for industrial applications.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• Develop advanced coatings in co-creation with customers, tailored to their specific applications and requirements. 

• Analyze technical challenges and translate them into concrete development and testing trajectories. 

• Work closely with the laboratory team in setting up, executing and interpreting tests. You will evaluate coating performance and make adjustments based on test results and customer feedback. 

• Identify new applications and innovation opportunities with both existing and prospective customers. 

• Ensure a smooth transition from laboratory results to effective production and closely monitor the implementation process. 

• Safeguard technical know-how and actively contribute to the further development of expertise within 
I-Coats’ product niche. 

• Report directly to the Technical Director.  

Your profile
 
 

• You hold a higher technical degree in a relevant field (preferably a Master’s degree in Chemistry, Materials Science or similar). 

• You have several years of experience in an R&D, application engineering or project-driven environment within a multidisciplinary context. 

• You have a strong affinity with coatings and chemical formulations. 

• You combine technical knowledge with a pragmatic mindset and a strong focus on applicability. 

• You work in a structured manner and are capable of independently managing complex projects. 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

• You speak Dutch very well. 

• You have a good command of English and solid knowledge of MS Office applications such as Excel and Word.
